title: Fried cocoy banana
instructions_raw:
Peel cocoys
Mix eggs and cinnamon in a bowl
Dip cocoy in mixture, then coat in the panko breadcrumbs
Heat oil at medium heat
Place cocoy in hot oil
Turn with a tong
Remove from pan when golden brown
